review_items.rationale:
Artifact 93abe7e62aef45ff98a9f01079a7310e version 1 executes O-config-copy version 1 in check acb05566ff2845d7ae7c8290db5c5b07. Config.Clone promises a copy, and RawNode.Status promises current status; AutoLeave is an ordinary semantic Config field, with no stated redaction. getStatus invokes Clone directly. The omitted field in the returned literal therefore supplies a concrete suspected value-loss mechanism, independently of the comparison outcome. The fixed driver bootstraps empty MemoryStorage instances, elects node 1 through actual messages, proposes remove-3 via supported implicit/explicit joint transitions, and applies the committed entry. It persists entries and HardState before delivery, detaches message bytes, processes every committed configuration before Advance and permits no concurrent method calls. MemoryStorage is a faithful no-crash substitute in this scope. No direct state assignment, fabricated response, forced role or transfer setup is used.

The observation point is immediately after ApplyConfChange and before Advance. Both the returned ConfState and the private live tracker flag are measured; Status is then called with no intervening protocol operation. Automatic exit cannot race this serialized call. The direct Clone diagnostic is invoked only after Status and does not establish the expectation. The oracle is equality of the exported AutoLeave field and the actual input source field, justified by the copy/current-status contract, not equality with an assumed mode. Its single prerequisite is copy_admitted with joint=true, and its independent identity is case/operation/node/index/entry_term. There is exactly one matching result in each subtest for node 1 entry 5 term 2. No expected-value filter excludes either true or false mode; the compared value is not an identity field. All CA_EVENT records are complete and the test completed without prerequisite failure.

Actual implicit-mode admission has live and ApplyConfChange-return AutoLeave=true. Its result has Status.Config.AutoLeave=false and direct Clone=false, while live_after remains true; incoming voters [1,2] and outgoing voters [1,2,3] correspond to the same joint history. Explicit-mode admission and result both have false. Thus the implicit-mode comparison violates the field-preservation requirement and the false-mode control holds. A false control alone would not prove correctness, and the successful Go test exit is not the violation oracle. The copied flag does not imply active mode changed: live_after=true directly contradicts that broader interpretation. Changer.EnterJoint sets the requested mode after copying, and LeaveJoint deliberately clears it, so these alternative consumers do not independently show protocol-state corruption. No issue found in correspondence for the scoped public status value loss.
